patterns.title: Forecast baseline and work commitment
patterns.documented_behavior: Backlog selection, assignment and estimation precede locking the sprint forecast. Existing tasks can be included without copying.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test baseline vs changed scope, lock permissions, late additions and metric provenance.
patterns.evidence_status: official public documentation reopened; runtime unverified

patterns.title: Timebox settings inheritance
patterns.documented_behavior: Default folder settings can be overridden; custom duration opt-in is irreversible; effort points may roll up and differ by assignee.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test default/override, irreversible setting disclosure, roles and plan gates.
patterns.evidence_status: official public documentation reopened; runtime unverified

patterns.title: Capacity-based scheduling
patterns.documented_behavior: Daily saved work allocations or percentage of assignee capacity can represent planned work; weekly display may include hours and capacity.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test zero capacity, partial days, calendar changes, actual/estimated distinction and accessibility.
patterns.evidence_status: official public documentation reopened; runtime unverified

patterns.title: Linked hierarchy and timeline
patterns.documented_behavior: Left task hierarchy and right dated bars share object identity; dependencies are represented in timeline.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test synchronized scroll, undated items, selection, permission and keyboard access.
patterns.evidence_status: official public documentation reopened; runtime unverified

patterns.title: Repository-to-space integration
patterns.documented_behavior: Repo and workspace admins have different setup roles; linked tasks reference external development activity.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test revocation, cross-repo access, duplicate webhook events and source links.
patterns.evidence_status: official public documentation reopened; runtime unverified

patterns.title: External calendar event boundary
patterns.documented_behavior: Calendar events sync with Planner; Outlook tasks do not sync as events. iCal is one-way. Planner allows contextual event creation and linked objects.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test event vs task, recurring events, timezone, conflicts, private visibility and disconnect.
patterns.evidence_status: official public documentation reopened; runtime unverified

patterns.title: Central connection management
patterns.documented_behavior: App Center manages integrations, search and modular features; role permissions gate personal connections; Drive account selection scoped per workspace.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test disabled vs unavailable, account switch, storage link access, consent and revocation.
patterns.evidence_status: official public documentation reopened; runtime unverified

patterns.title: Integration automation setup
patterns.documented_behavior: Prebuilt or custom trigger/action plus conditions; eligible connection, feature toggle and plan are prerequisites.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test missing connection, role/plan gate, validation, retry, audit and duplicate effects.
patterns.evidence_status: official public documentation reopened; runtime unverified

patterns.title: Explicit migration compatibility
patterns.documented_behavior: Import format and source have distinct mapping and loss boundaries. Spreadsheet rows capped at 10,000; Notion properties mapped to text; Jira mapping and time ownership differ.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test preflight, source-specific report, batching, identifiers, type conversions and ownership.
patterns.evidence_status: official public documentation reopened; runtime unverified

patterns.title: Export scope and entitlement
patterns.documented_behavior: Exports differ by content type and plan; CSV attachment links are distinct from bytes; quota visibility can be aggregate only.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test scope, entitlement, snapshot, missing attachment and transparent quota messaging.
patterns.evidence_status: official public documentation reopened; runtime unverified

patterns.title: Document and page sharing scope
patterns.documented_behavior: Document and page access can target different subjects and hierarchy locations.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test effective permissions, inheritance, direct link access and revocation.
patterns.evidence_status: official public documentation reopened; runtime unverified

patterns.title: SSO and provisioning distinction
patterns.documented_behavior: SSO sign-in and SCIM provisioning are distinct. Multiple Entra tenants or SCIM require custom SAML route according to vendor.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test account link, provisioning, lockout recovery and administrator permission.
patterns.evidence_status: official public documentation reopened; runtime unverified

patterns.title: Container archive and restore
patterns.documented_behavior: Archive retains searchable Space; deletion has bounded Trash recovery and role restrictions.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test descendants, links, restore scope, permission and expired recovery.
patterns.evidence_status: official public documentation reopened; runtime unverified

patterns.title: Voice capture into comment draft
patterns.documented_behavior: Recording starts from microphone, cancel discards, finish uploads audio to draft, and recording hub collects clips; guest permissions differ.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test microphone consent, draft deletion, upload pending/error, keyboard and transcription status.
patterns.evidence_status: official public documentation reopened; runtime unverified

patterns.title: Central recording library and review
patterns.documented_behavior: Recordings collected in hub; sharing link via row action; commenting requires workspace membership in documented preview flow.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test link exposure, role, media processing, access revocation and comments.
patterns.evidence_status: official public documentation reopened; runtime unverified

patterns.title: Mobile home and desktop entry
patterns.documented_behavior: Mobile default Home can change; desktop command bar uses configurable global hotkey and requires background app.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test fallback, focus, shortcut collisions, permission and platform differences.
patterns.evidence_status: official public documentation reopened; runtime unverified
